_notes.boardName: Optional. Shown as a tooltip on the board-as-of line. Default: "<owner> project <projectNumber>".
_notes.repos: Optional. Repos to fetch created dates for. Default: the repos seen on the board.
_notes.privateRepos: Optional. Exact repo names that are private. Hidden by name in the stage view (?stage). Default: none.
_notes.repoLabels: Optional. Repo name to the label on its crest cards. Default: the repo name.
_notes.stage: Optional. { repos, hideLabels, ids } for the stage view. repos defaults to every repo that is not in privateRepos.
